raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misapplied the core principle of separation by magnetism, incorrectly selecting a screen filter (which separates by size, not magnetic properties) instead of a magnet. They also showed internal inconsistency by labeling “screen filter” as option C, when C is actually the horseshoe magnet. The task was prematurely marked complete without systematic evaluation or engaging specialists.
